description: Read committed 24V/S06C and safety R1; flag uncommitted S06D/F claims rather than invent evidence. Deliver baseline and control variant table.
Inventory exact candidate control IC/MOS/diode/inductor and official SPICE artifacts; URLs, license, SHA256, supported simulator, versions, model limitations; do not rewrite original model.
Reconcile 24V 21.6-26.4V, 170V 164.9-175.1V, ripple <=1Vpp, normal peak<=180V, startup<=1s, recovery<=100ms, fault peak target<=195V. Include revised bleeder delta and 0V cold startup.
Use official LT3757A reference and native LTspice only if installed. Replay unmodified vendor design first; record original sources and console log/waveforms; no invented PASS.

Replay original TI UCC28C43 controller fixture in supported engine, keeping original models immutable. Classify tool/setup/model/electrical failures separately; never equate controller-only oscillation to power stage qualification.
Qualify exact candidate MOSFET, diode and magnetics with independent fixtures. Hot L(I,T)/loss claims unsupported must be HOLD. Nonlinear switching, pins and timestep sensitivity mandatory.

Codex-led comparative analysis of LT3757A versus UCC28C43 using both successful and failed native model evidence. DeepSeek prepares reasoned comparison only; do not mix controller nets. If neither candidate qualified, hold rather than pretend one works.

Execute authentic 0V COUT startup with real controller model, no precharged 170V source. Measure inductor current, demagnetization, duty, gate, startup time, clamp, no forced PWM shortcut. FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE if no solver.

Reproduce nominal 170V regulation and input/load corner steps at required baseline. Record ripple, peak, recovery, compensation and at least 2 timestep settings; no claim of overall qualification without full power model.
Independent negative review: inspect raw netlist/log/wave and worst-case evidence, reproduce counterexamples, challenge missing I_limit and startup; no self-approval or release.
